title: Shorten transactions that hold a deployment run row for minutes
text: Waiters on a deployment run row now refuse as run_busy within 2 seconds and retry, but the holders are unchanged: QA materialize, rematerialize and qa_stage.dispatch transactions held one run row for 10 to 30+ minutes on 2026-10-20, and every retry against such a holder is refused until it commits. QA progress on that run stalls for the whole hold. Still owed: find the long work inside those transactions and commit or move it outside the run row lock, then choose a write deadline from the per-function duration_ms the dashboard Performance page already records.
